verdict.rationale: The evidence does not show a built-in AI assistant inside Sketch. Its AI capabilities run through a built-in local MCP server that lets external AI clients such as ChatGPT or Claude drive the app, and the vendor stresses there are 'no tokens to buy, no extra tiers, and no add-ons', which points to bring-your-own external assistants rather than a native one. Exposing an MCP server for outside clients is an adjacent building block, not a built-in assistant users delegate to, so it earns no credit toward this story.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can delegate tasks to a built-in AI assistant inside the product

citations.quote: Sketch includes a built-in MCP Server, a lightweight local-only web server that lets AI clients like ChatGPT or Claude interact directly with Sketch.
Connect any MCP-compatible AI client you like to Sketch. There are no tokens to buy, no extra tiers, and no add-ons.
